actual_scope: On the selected PR1094 T16 owner map, one-helper-per-physical-family does not follow from the per-route greedy spectator chart: every width-at-most-8 spectator list contains frame index 0, while a width-9 same-family pair has empty spectator lists, valid charts, and a repeated family.
scope_change_reason: The card asks whether one selected supplier obligation follows from its source-bound checks. This names that obligation as family uniqueness on the published 69120-role map and compares it with the spectator-chart predicate. The PR626 timing-only diagnostic stays the orientation control and is not reported as a new acceptance bug.
bottleneck_link: Family uniqueness is part of the selected complex supplier whole-call hosting contract. Separating it from the spectator chart shows which check still has to be paid before a width-9 co-hosting mechanism could be considered. This audit does not change kappa.
stop_rule: Stop after the 112 port bases, all 48384 pending axes, the selected 69120 roles, and one width-9 witness pair. No packing search and no frontier1094 cold replay.
evidence: python3 -B research/selected-width9-spectator-gap/verify.py prints PASS_SELECTED_WIDTH9_SPECTATOR_GAP. Witness family 672, child 8, port 0, offsets 0 and 9. The same command under python3 -O prints the identical receipt.
author: AI-assisted research session
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance was used to read the pinned sources, choose the obligation, and write the checker. No model or coding-agent product is named here.

open_questions.question: Can two width-9 helpers with disjoint pending blocks share one physical family for one invocation under the scalar residual contract?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The spectator chart accepts that pair and the owner rule rejects it. A scalar rejection would give uniqueness a lemma other than spectator collision. A scalar acceptance would mean the selected hosting rule is stricter than the chart.
open_questions.first_step: Evaluate the emitted [3, child, offset] route and the residual adapter on child 8, port 0, offsets 0 and 9, inside one invocation.
open_questions.blocked_by: The inherited whole-call hosting assumption and the emitter one-owner assertion. This package does not rebuild the controller.
